pathSubtitle: Run and participate in meetings — from setting the agenda to handling disagreements and closing with action points.

lessons.title: Starting a Meeting
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Starting a Meeting successfully

questions.prompt: How many original agenda items were there?
questions.feedback: Correct! There were three original agenda items.

questions.prompt: What is the blocker for phase two?
questions.feedback: Correct! The blocker is waiting for sign-off from legal.

questions.prompt: What does "agenda" mean?
options: a list of items to discuss at a meeting
questions.feedback: Correct! "agenda" means a list of items to discuss at a meeting.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "on track"?
options: The agenda for today has five points.
We have one blocker — approval from management.
The project is on track for the October deadline.
questions.feedback: Correct! "The project is on track for the October deadline." is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "blocker" mean?
options: a list of items to discuss at a meeting
questions.feedback: Correct! "blocker" means a problem that stops progress.

lessons.title: Presenting Data
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Presenting Data successfully

questions.prompt: What was total revenue growth in Q3?
questions.feedback: Correct! Total revenue was up 12% in Q3.

questions.prompt: Why are North America numbers flat?
questions.feedback: Correct! The slowdown is believed to be seasonal.

questions.prompt: What does "revenue" mean?
options: not growing or declining; staying the same
questions.feedback: Correct! "revenue" means income from business activity.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "performing above expectations"?
options: Sales were flat in the third quarter.
The new product is performing above expectations.
questions.feedback: Correct! "The new product is performing above expectations." is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "flat" mean?
options: not growing or declining; staying the same
questions.feedback: Correct! "flat" means not growing or declining; staying the same.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker use to support their argument?

questions.prompt: What solution does the speaker propose?
questions.feedback: Correct! The speaker proposes a hybrid model.

questions.prompt: What does "push back" mean?
options: a questionnaire measuring how committed and motivated employees feel
to express disagreement or resistance to an idea

Good collaboration is key to project success.

options: to express disagreement or resistance to an idea
a questionnaire measuring how committed and motivated employees feel

lessons.title: Closing & Action Points
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Closing & Action Points successfully

questions.prompt: Who is responsible for following up with the client?
questions.feedback: Correct! Maria is responsible for following up with the client.

questions.prompt: When should Maria send an email to the client?
options: If the call fails by Tuesday afternoon
questions.feedback: Correct! Maria should email if the call fails by Tuesday afternoon.

questions.prompt: What does "summarise" mean?
options: a specific task someone must complete after a meeting
a reserve budget for unexpected costs
to give the main points briefly
questions.feedback: Correct! "summarise" means to give the main points briefly.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "action point"?
options: Let me summarise what we discussed.
We always include a 10% contingency in project budgets.
You have three action points from today's meeting.
questions.feedback: Correct! "You have three action points from today's meeting." is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "contingency" mean?
options: to give the main points briefly
a specific task someone must complete after a meeting
a reserve budget for unexpected costs
questions.feedback: Correct! "contingency" means a reserve budget for unexpected costs.

lessons.title: High-Stakes Executive Meeting
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed High-Stakes Executive Meeting successfully

questions.prompt: What are the two outstanding due diligence concerns?
questions.feedback: Correct! The concerns are IP ownership and pending litigation.

questions.prompt: What protects the company if the IP issue isn't resolved in 60 days?
options: A fallback clause in the term sheet
questions.feedback: Correct! A fallback clause in the term sheet protects the company.

questions.prompt: What does "due diligence" mean?
options: the process of taking legal action
an estimate of how much something is worth
a thorough investigation before completing a business deal
questions.feedback: Correct! "due diligence" means a thorough investigation before completing a business deal.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "litigation"?
options: We completed due diligence before signing the contract.
The company is involved in ongoing litigation.
questions.feedback: Correct! "The company is involved in ongoing litigation." is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "valuation" mean?
options: a thorough investigation before completing a business deal
the process of taking legal action
an estimate of how much something is worth
questions.feedback: Correct! "valuation" means an estimate of how much something is worth.
